w: When a session begins or resumes
m: how session started: startup, resume, clear, compact, fork
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only"
d: Context only: additionalContext, initialUserMessage, sessionTitle, watchPaths, reloadSkills; plain stdout becomes context. Only command and mcp_tool types

w: When you start Claude Code with --init-only, or with --init or --maintenance in -p mode
b: No. "Exit code and stderr are ignored"
d: None; JSON discarded. Only command runs (mcp_tool always skipped)

w: When a prompt is submitted, before Claude processes it" (also scheduled tasks, background subagent reports, cross-session messages)
b: Yes. "Blocks the prompt, so it never reaches Claude"
d: top-level decision:"block", reason (shown to user, not context); hookSpecificOutput additionalContext, sessionTitle, suppressOriginalPrompt; plain stdout becomes context

w: When a user-typed command expands into a prompt, before it reaches Claude
b: Yes. "Blocks the expansion"
d: decision:"block", reason, additionalContext; plain stdout becomes context

w: Before a tool call executes. Can block it
m: tool name (Bash, Edit|Write, mcp__.*); never EndConversation
b: Yes. "Blocks the tool call"; stderr becomes denial reason for Claude

w: When a tool call needs a permission decision
b: No via exit code: "Exit code 2 isn't honored for this event"; deny via decision object
d: hookSpecificOutput decision.behavior (allow/deny), decision.updatedInput, decision.updatedPermissions (allow only), decision.message, decision.interrupt (deny only)

w: When auto mode denies a tool call, including denials without a classifier verdict
b: No. "Exit code and stderr are ignored because the denial already occurred"
d: hookSpecificOutput retry: true (ignored for no-verdict denials)

w: After a tool call succeeds
b: No. "Shows stderr to Claude; the tool already ran"
d: decision:"block" + reason (adds reason next to result), additionalContext, classifierContext, updatedToolOutput, updatedMCPToolOutput

w: After a tool call fails
b: No. "Shows stderr to Claude; the tool already failed"
d: additionalContext (decision table also lists top-level decision)

w: After a full batch of parallel tool calls resolves, before the next model call
b: Yes. "Stops the agentic loop before the next model call"

w: When Claude Code sends a notification
m: type: permission_prompt, idle_prompt, auth_success, elicitation_dialog, elicitation_url_dialog, elicitation_complete, elicitation_response, agent_needs_input, agent_completed, quota_auto_resume_fired, quota_auto_resume_stale, quota_auto_resume_disabled
b: No. "Exit code and stderr are ignored"
d: None; systemMessage/continue discarded; terminalSequence still emitted

w: While assistant message text is displayed
b: No. "The original text is displayed"
d: displayContent (display-only; transcript and Claude keep original)

w: When a subagent is spawned
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only"

w: When a subagent finishes
b: Yes. "Prevents the subagent from stopping"
d: Same as Stop: decision:"block" + reason (becomes subagent's next instruction), additionalContext

w: When a task is being created via TaskCreate
b: Yes. "Rolls back the task creation"
d: exit 2 or decision:"block" + reason; continue:false ignored

w: When a task is being marked as completed
b: Yes. "Prevents the task from being marked as completed"
d: exit 2; continue:false + stopReason (only when a teammate finishing triggered it)

w: When Claude finishes responding" (not on user interrupt)
b: Yes. "Prevents Claude from stopping, continues the conversation"

w: When the turn ends due to an API error
m: error type: rate_limit, overloaded, authentication_failed, oauth_org_not_allowed, account_on_hold, billing_error, invalid_request, model_not_found, server_error, max_output_tokens, cloud_credential_error, unknown
b: No. "Output and exit code are ignored, except terminalSequence"

w: When an agent team teammate is about to go idle
b: Yes. "Prevents the teammate from going idle, so it continues working"

w: When a CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/*.md file is loaded into context
m: load reason: session_start, nested_traversal, path_glob_match, include, compact
b: No. "Exit code is ignored"

w: When a configuration file changes during a session
m: source: user_settings, project_settings, local_settings, policy_settings, skills
b: Yes. "Blocks the configuration change from taking effect (except policy_settings)"

w: When the working directory changes, for example when Claude executes a cd command
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only"

w: When a working directory is added mid-session via /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root control request
b: No. "Stderr goes to the debug log; the directory is already added"
d: None (systemMessage goes to Claude as context for slash_command)

w: When a watched file changes on disk. The matcher field specifies which filenames to watch
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only"

w: When a worktree is being created via --worktree, isolation: \"worktree\", or for a background session. Replaces default git behavior
b: Yes. "Any non-zero exit code causes worktree creation to fail"
d: path return: command prints path as last stdout line; HTTP returns hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath

w: When a worktree is being removed at session exit, when a subagent finishes, or when you delete a background session
b: Yes. non-zero exit fails removal "if the directory still exists afterward"

w: Before context compaction
b: Yes. "Blocks compaction"

w: After context compaction completes
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only"

w: Before Claude Code applies a model switch that you or a client requested. Can block the switch
b: Yes. "Blocks the model switch and shows stderr to the user"; timeout also blocks
d: permissionDecision (allow/deny/ask, no defer), permissionDecisionReason, or decision:"block"; precedence deny > ask > allow

w: After the session's model changes, including changes Claude Code makes on its own
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only; the model already switched"

w: When an MCP server requests user input during a tool call
b: Yes. "Denies the elicitation" (stderr shown nowhere)

w: After a user responds to an MCP elicitation, before the response is sent back to the server
b: Yes. "Blocks the response (action becomes decline)"

w: When a session terminates
m: reason: clear, resume, logout, prompt_input_exit, other
b: No. "Shows stderr to user only"
